contract.angular: bilinear S and T directly at actual integer knot coordinates; clamp edges
contract.depth: tau-linear T and exponential segment-fraction S
contract.geometry: prefix independent; exact holdout depth controls L
contract.lighting: captured point-sun dir1, normalized unit radiance

limitations: Numerical and cost feasibility only; passing does not approve 40km haze or a production implementation.
Original capture cards cannot provide static long-range cloud-bank truth.
Normalized unit-radiance S excludes production radiance and shadow-map lighting.
CPU runtime and estimated texture reads are not FPS or measured GPU time.
No native Windows, actual-D3D, TAA, flight appearance, state, Reset, or failure-recovery behavior is verified.
provenance_note: Numerical arrays and images are cached from numeric-report.json and numeric-source.py; finalization changed only bindings and labels.
